title: Release-prep custodian: bump version to 0.6.4 and add CHANGELOG ## 0.6.4 section
definition_of_done: `reference-impl/CHANGELOG.md` contains a new `## 0.6.4` section summarising the two changes from CLV-58 and CLV-59: (1) new `lib/walker-config.ts` loader and `cloverleaf-cli walker-default-concurrency` subcommand; (2) walker `SKILL.md` step 1 now calls the subcommand instead of hard-coding the default, with startup info line and stop-and-report on malformed config.
Any tests in `reference-impl/tests/` that assert the package version string are updated to expect `0.6.4`.
All pre-existing tests in `reference-impl/tests/` continue to pass.
acceptance_criteria: `reference-impl/CHANGELOG.md` contains a section header matching `## 0.6.4` and enumerates the loader+CLI work (CLV-58) and the SKILL.md change (CLV-59).
This task runs only after CLV-58 and CLV-59 have both merged (enforced by DAG edges).
